popover-description: Download the template, add your {{entity}}, then upload the file to create or update {{entity}} in bulk.
current-imports-description: Check progress, retry failed jobs, or download error rows.
no-imports-running-description: Your latest CSV uploads will appear here so you can follow progress and fix any row-level errors.
step-download-description: Start with the template so your {{entity}} columns match the importer.
step-fill-description: Fill in each row with the values you want to create or update.
step-upload-description: We will validate the file and begin the import right away.
drop-csv: Drop your CSV here or choose a file
drop-csv-description: Upload one file at a time to import {{entity}} data in bulk.
no-sample-values: No values in the sampled rows
duplicate-field: Another column already fills this field.
duplicate-warning: Two columns point at the same field. Pick a different field or skip one of them.
no-header-row: This file has no header row to read.
no-imports-yet-description: CSV imports started from your modules will appear here with their status, processed rows, and any error files you may need to review.
no-entity-imports-yet-description: {{entity}} imports will appear here after someone uploads a CSV file. Error files will also be available here whenever a job needs attention.
try-again-later: Try refreshing this page again in a moment.
import-started-description: {{fileName}} is being imported with {{total}} mapped columns.
import-cancelled-description: The import process has been cancelled
import-restarted-description: The import process has been restarted
import-resumed-description: The import process has been resumed
upload-failed-description: File upload completed but no file key was returned
invalid-file-key-description: File upload completed but file key is invalid
missing-entity-type-import: Entity type is required to start import
missing-entity-type-template: Entity type is required to download template
export-started-description: Your export has been started. You will be notified when it is ready.
export-restarted-description: Export has been resumed from the last position.
no-exports-yet-description: Exports started from your modules will appear here with their status, processed rows, and the file to download once it is ready.
no-entity-exports-yet-description: {{entity}} exports will appear here after someone starts one. The finished file will be available for download.
export-popover-description: Create a CSV with the fields you choose, then download it once the file is ready.
export-selected-hint: Only the currently selected records will be included.
export-in-view-hint: We will use the records currently visible with your applied filters.
recent-exports-description: Download completed files or retry failed exports.
no-recent-exports-description: Your generated CSV files will show up here so you can download them again or keep track of export progress.
export-confirm: Create this CSV export with the selected fields?
export-fields-description: Choose the fields to include in your export file.
